houseFormExemplars.walkScript: Look at winter and cold. Winter is a season; cold is how it feels. Summer is a season too, so warm fits. Holiday and August share summer, not the feeling.

stem.prompt: Find the connection in the first pair, then complete the second.

houseFormExemplars.walkScript: Start with minute and hour. Many minutes make one hour, a bigger unit. So hours make one day, bigger again. Clock and week miss that step in size.

stem.prompt: Find the connection in the first pair, then complete the second.

houseFormExemplars.walkScript: Begin with leaf and tree. A leaf is part of the tree. In the same way, a petal is part of a flower. Garden and stem are not the whole flower.

stem.prompt: Find the connection in the first pair, then complete the second.

houseFormExemplars.walkScript: Read captain and ship first. A captain steers the ship he leads. So a pilot steers a plane, and plane fits. Airport and wing sit by planes, steering nothing.

stem.prompt: Find the connection in the first pair, then complete the second.

houseFormExemplars.walkScript: Take the pair bee and honey. A bee gives honey to eat. Milk is what a cow gives. Farm and grass go with cows, not food.

houseFormExemplars.walkScript: First read sheep and lamb. A lamb is the baby of a sheep. Likewise a foal is the baby of a horse. Stable and hay go with horses, not young.
